content.title: Archrock Beats Q3 Earnings & Revenue Estimates, Both Up Y/Y
content.summary: AROC expects contract operations revenues to range from $1.27 billion to $1.28 billion, supported by a healthy adjusted gross margin of 71-71.5%.

content.title: Pembina Pipeline Q3 Earnings & Revenues Miss Estimates, Both Down Y/Y
content.summary: PBA expects 2025 adjusted EBITDA in the range of C$4.25 billion to C$4.35 billion compared with the previous guidance of C$4.23 billion to C$4.43 billion.

content.title: Delek US Q3 Earnings & Revenues Beat Estimates, Adjusted EBITDA Up Y/Y
content.summary: DK expects total crude throughput in the range of 252,000-284,000 bpd and total throughput in the band of 271,000-303,000 bpd for the fourth quarter of 2025.

content.title: TC Energy Q3 Earnings Match Estimates, Revenues Beat, Both Fall Y/Y
content.summary: TRP anticipates its 2025 comparable EBITDA to be between C$10.8 billion and C$11 billion, with net Capex to be between C$5.5 billion and C$6 billion.

content.title: Northern Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates, Revenues Miss, Both Down Y/Y
content.summary: NOG expects total production of 132,500-134,000 barrels of oil equivalent per day, with oil production in the range of 75,000-76,500 barrels per day for 2025.

content.title: USA Compression Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates, Revenues Rise Y/Y
content.summary: USAC expects adjusted EBITDA of $610-$620 million and distributable cash flow between $370 million and $380 million for 2025.

content.title: Marathon Q3 Earnings Miss Estimates, Revenues Beat, Expenses Down Y/Y
content.summary: MPC, Findlay, OH-based oil and gas refining and marketing company, expects refining operating costs to average $5.80 per barrel in the fourth quarter of 2025.

content.title: Williams Q3 Earnings and Revenues Miss Estimates, Expenses Down Y/Y
content.summary: WMB expects 2025 growth capital expenditures to be between $3.95 billion and $4.25 billion, with a leverage ratio estimated at a midpoint of 3.7x.

content.title: Coterra Q3 Earnings Miss Estimates, Revenues Beat, Expenses Rise Y/Y
content.summary: CTRA expects total production of 772-782 MBoepd, natural gas output of 2,925-2,965 MMcfpd and oil volumes in the range of 159-161 MBopd for 2025
